# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Follow the canonical instructions in [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and the detailed workflow in [`../docs/agent-playbook.md`](../docs/agent-playbook.md).

Key constraints: Node.js 14 and Yarn Classic, Chrome 35/webOS compatibility, evidence-aware roadmap updates, loader-boundary playback scenarios, explicit TV-validation limits, and strict URL/token/privacy scrubbing in diagnostics and telemetry.
